layout.title: Account
layout.subtitle: Manage your personal settings and access tokens

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Rotate the password you use to sign in. Your other sessions will be signed out.
password.setSubtitle: This account currently signs in through an identity provider. Set a password to also sign in directly.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
password.invalidCurrent: That is not your current password.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.subtitle: Sign in without a password using your device, a hardware key, or a password manager.
passkeys.lastAuthMethod: Add another passkey or set a password before removing this one.

totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)
totp.subtitle: Add a time-based code as a second sign-in factor.
totp.skippedWithPasskey: Skipped when you sign in with a passkey.

totp.savedCheck: I have saved these codes in a safe place.
totp.disableSubtitle: Enter a current 6-digit code to confirm.
totp.setupFailed: Unable to set up two-factor authentication. Try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Update your display name. This is how other users will see you.
profile.name: Name

tokens.title: API Tokens
tokens.subtitle: Manage your personal access tokens.
tokens.copyWarning: Make sure to copy your token now. You won't be able to see it again!
tokens.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this token?
tokens.revokeDescription: Are you sure you want to revoke this token? Any applications using it will lose access immediately.
tokens.createDescription: Create a personal access token for API access.
tokens.tokenCreatedDescription: Copy your token now. You won't be able to see it again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.

sessions.revokeCurrentDescription: This is your current session — revoking it will sign you out immediately.
sessions.signOutOthersDescription: This will sign out {{count}} other session, but keep your session on this device active.
sessions.signOutOthersDescription_other: This will sign out {{count}} other sessions, but keep your session on this device active.
sessions.failedSignOutOthers: Failed to sign out other sessions

notifications.phoneAfterAddHint: After adding, verify the number to start receiving SMS / voice alerts.
notifications.smsConsentNotice: By adding this number you agree to receive SolidPing alerts by SMS from Webingenia: incident, escalation and recovery notices for the checks you configure, plus verification codes and test messages you trigger yourself. Message frequency varies by incident. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel, HELP for help.
notifications.noProviderHint: No SMS provider is configured for this organization yet. You can add the number, but it won't receive SMS or voice alerts until an admin sets up Twilio.

verify.dialogDescription: We'll send a 6-digit code to {{phone}} on WhatsApp. Enter it below to confirm this number can receive WhatsApp alerts.
